crossRefs.note: As Yahweh commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
You shall put it before the veil that is by the ark of the covenant, before the mercy seat that is over the covenant…
There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on…
It shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh…
There I will meet with the children of Israel; and the place shall be sanctified by my glory.

parallels.note: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant, where I meet with you.

translations.web: You shall beat some of it very small, and put some of it before the covenant in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be to you most holy.
translations.bsb: Grind some of it into fine powder and place it in front of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.
translations.asv: and thou shalt beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tent of meeting, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.
